transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the waste-disposition huddle. We've got eighteen totes of spent solvent from the cleaning process staged in the waste area awaiting disposition. I understand no pickup has been booked yet, and I'll need to sign off on the final disposition and shipment plan once we've reviewed everything. Let's hear from the environmental compliance specialist and logistics coordinator on their findings before I sign off.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My laboratory review this morning classified the solvent as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II, rather than routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. The classification is not yet in the formal waste register because I'm waiting for the plant manager's disposition signature.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've confirmed with the licensed hazardous-waste carrier that it will accept these 18 drums only for a Friday 16:00 pickup, provided they are arranged on exactly 3 pallets and the manifest is submitted by 12:00 Friday. I haven't booked the pickup yet because the waste classification was awaiting confirmation, which Jonas has now provided.
transcript.speaker: A3
